rationale: Of the three supported archive formats (zip 12 MB, gzip 9 MB, zstd 6 MB), zstd produces the smallest output at 6 MB — a 33% reduction over gzip and 50% over zip. All three formats are explicitly listed as valid choices; no decision record or hard constraint rules zstd out. The note that the downstream importer has not been upgraded is acknowledged, but it does not disqualify zstd from the supported-choices list, so the smallest format is applied as requested.
